ShortDescription.Value: Import OpenStreetMap data and generate roads into Cities Skylines 2

Publish.LongDescription:
## This mod is a work in progress! The roads (especially roads that are elevated) are generating incorrectly.
A **Cities: Skylines 2** mod that imports real-world road network data from **[OpenStreetMap](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/About_OpenStreetMap) (OSM)** XML files and procedurally generates the corresponding road networks inside the game world.
## Usage ### 1. Download OSM Data OSM data can be downloaded from a variety of sources. \ I recommend [terraining.ateliernonta.com](https://terraining.ateliernonta.com) (see the [GitHub repo](https://github.com/nonta1234/terraining-heightmap-generator#readme) for details).
#### Note A matching heightmap from [terraining.ateliernonta.com](https://terraining.ateliernonta.com) can improve results.
[Learn more about heightmaps in Cities Skylines II](https://cs2.paradoxwikis.com/Map_Creation#Heightmaps)
### 2. Launch editor Open the in-game editor.
### 3. Open OSM Importer Tool Select **OSM Importer Tool** in the editor to open the mod tool panel.
### 4. Import the OSM Data Use **OSM file path** to pick your `.osm` file. Adjust options if needed, then click **Load OSM Data** and **Continue**.
#### Note Loading may freeze the game for a few seconds while the file is parsed.
### 5. Generate roads Choose which loaded road types to generate, then click **Generate Roads**.
#### Note Generation can take some time, especially for dense road networks.
### Feedback Report bugs, request features, or provide general feedback by creating an [issue on the Github repo](https://github.com/digiphreniac/cs2-osm-importer/issues). \ Please look at the existing issues before creating one to avoid creating duplicates.
